# Vishal Akshintala

> Registered Advocate practicing litigation and corporate advisory in AI governance, data privacy, cybersecurity law, and space law, across India, the EU, UK, US, and APAC. Court representation across Telangana and pan-India on referral. NALSAR University of Law alumnus, ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer, CIPP/E and AIGP (IAPP), affiliated with Radhical Global Attorneys (Hyderabad, India).

Vishal Akshintala represents clients in litigation before Telangana courts and regulatory forums — including cybercrime matters (both complainants and accused), data protection grievances, and commercial/TDSAT disputes — and separately advises organizations on AI risk classification under the EU AI Act, data fiduciary obligations under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA) 2023, cybersecurity incident-response obligations under CERT-In directions, and jurisdictional questions in space law including orbital data infrastructure and satellite AI systems under the 1967 Outer Space Treaty. He also delivers one-on-one and cohort AI governance training programs for legal and compliance teams.
